segments.name: Franchise
segments.description: Franchises the Planet Fitness brand and collects royalties and advertising fund contributions from franchisees in the United States and several international markets.
segments.evidence: Our Franchise segment includes operations related to our franchising business in the United States, Puerto Rico, Canada, Panama, Mexico and Australia, as well as revenues and expenses of the NAFs.

segments.name: Corporate-owned clubs
segments.description: Operates company-owned Planet Fitness clubs in the U.S., Canada and Spain, earning membership dues from club members.
segments.evidence: Our Corporate-owned clubs segment includes operations with respect to all corporate-owned clubs throughout the U.S., Canada, and Spain.

segments.name: Equipment
segments.description: Sells cardio and strength equipment to franchisee-owned clubs in the U.S., Canada and Mexico.
segments.evidence: The Equipment segment includes the sale of equipment to franchisee-owned clubs in the U.S, Canada and Mexico.

revenueModel.text: Franchisees pay royalties, advertising fund contributions and equipment purchases; club members pay monthly dues and annual fees.
revenueModel.evidence: In 2025, over 90% of both our corporate-owned club and franchise revenues consisted of recurring revenue streams, which include royalties, monthly dues and annual fees.
